name: Megan Roethler
statement:
Since graduating the University of Northern Iowa in 2020 with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in painting, my work has expanded into a variety of creative outlets. Small scale painting and drawing, digital rendering, mural painting, tattooing, and sculpture are all avenues I have created commissioned work in. From these experiences, I have woven together a wide and unique array of differing skill sets, methods, and knowledge in my approach to creating artwork for clients.

My primary day job as a tattooer gives me a strong sense for working with others to create collaborative works of art, and my academic experience gives me extensive trials in the application, technique, and necessary components of successful paintings at a large scale. In my compositions, I aim to create bold, bright, and readable designs that are unique, colorful, and fun to look at.
